arrival.title: The Arrival
arrival.objective: Speak to Ranger Dan by the west road at Acacia Outpost.

first_bond.title: Your First Wildbond
first_bond.objective: Take the west road to Route 01. Approach wildlife or search tall grass. In battle, weaken it, then choose Wildbond.

injury.title: The Disturbance
injury.objective: Take the east road through Acacia Outpost to Riverine Woodland. Help the injured Pangolet beside the bridge.

tracks.title: Strange Tracks
tracks.objective: Inspect the tracks on the east bank, across the bridge.

passage.title: The First Expedition
passage.objective: Follow the east bank north to the rockfall. Use Ratelit's Burrow Breaker nearby with G / Abilities.

evidence.title: The Damaged Shelter
evidence.objective: Inspect the damaged shelter beyond the cleared rockfall.

report.title: A Place to Recover
report.objective: Return west to Ranger Dan at Acacia Outpost and report your findings.

shelter.title: Building Your Sanctuary
shelter.objective: Gather 6 wood, 2 stone and 4 fiber. At Acacia Outpost, open Camp and place a Creature Shelter on clear ground.

care.title: A Keeper's Promise
care.objective: Approach your Creature Shelter at Acacia Outpost and interact to care for your companions.

mystery.title: Something in the Wild
mystery.objective: Inspect the resonance stone beside your shelter. Ratelit is waiting.

complete.title: Chapter 1 Complete
complete.objective: Something in the Wild — complete. Your sanctuary remains open. Check Field Notes, explore, or save and rest.

arrival: Welcome to Acacia Outpost, Wildkeeper. I'm Dan. The Resonance Band on your wrist helps you listen to creatures — but trust has to be earned.
Pangolet will travel with you. Move with WASD, run with Shift and jump with Space. On a phone, use the pad and action buttons. Interact with people and supplies using E or Interact.

First, take the west road to Route 01. Meet a wild creature. In battle, choose a move, watch its vitality, then try Wildbond. If it refuses, keep trying gently. Sanna's clinic here can restore your party.

We've had reports of unusual animal activity near the Riverine Woodland, beyond our east gate. Once you've formed a bond, investigate. Your next task and its direction are always in Field Notes and the mission panel.
nuisance: A honey badger barrels out of the grass with somebody's lunch. A furious bird follows. The badger stops to argue with a rock.
That one is Ratelit. He isn't assigned to anybody. He just keeps turning up. Keep an eye on him — preferably from a safe distance.
injury: A young Pangolet is curled beside the riverbank. There is no wound from teeth or claws. Its scales tremble when your Resonance Band hums.
Easy. I'm here to help. A little water, a cool leaf and a quiet place. We won't force you to move.
Its breathing settles. Nearby wildlife has fled away from the east bank, leaving scorched grass and deep, uneven tracks.
Ratelit noses your pack, steals the spare food and stays beside the Pangolet. He will help investigate even if you haven't bonded with him.
tracks: Three trails meet here. One runs toward the river. Another doubles back in panic. The third cuts straight toward an old shelter to the north.
The soil is warm, but there is no fire. Your Band gives a single sharp pulse. Follow the east bank north to the cracked rockfall.
Whatever frightened them didn't chase them. It passed through them.
evidence: Inside the damaged shelter, claw marks stop at a smooth black stone. The roof has collapsed outward. Not a single splinter is burned.
You record the shelter's position and a sketch of the stone. The Band's hum rises until Ratelit puts a muddy paw on your wrist. Silence.
We need a safe place for that Pangolet. I'll tell Dan what we found.
report: You did the right thing helping it first. We can study the disturbance once the creatures are safe.
Gather 6 wood, 2 stone and 4 fiber from the marked supplies. They regrow, so you can never run out. Come back here and use Camp to place a Creature Shelter on a clear patch.
Then interact beside the shelter to care for your companions. Any shelter you've already built here will do. This is your sanctuary now — the creatures are neighbours, not trophies.
resonance: The shelter falls quiet. Pangolet curls tightly. Even the birds stop calling. A blue shimmer gathers around a stone beneath the new roof.
Your Resonance Band flashes. The Wild Current feels like a storm caught under your skin. Ratelit walks straight toward it.
That's impossible. No creature should be able to withstand that.
Ratelit's eyes glow. For a moment, the shimmer bends toward him. He scratches his ear. Then bites the stone.
Ratelit. That is absolutely not food.
The pulse breaks. The creatures settle. Ratelit leans against your boot as if nothing happened.
I've seen resonance storms before. I've never seen one answer a creature. We'll find out what this means. Together.
Your first expedition is complete. Your sanctuary and companions remain yours. The mystery of Ratelit and the Wild Current has only begun. Save in the menu before leaving.
complete: The Pangolet is safe. Your shelter is ready. And Ratelit has adopted your boots. Rest, explore, and record what you find. The Wild Current can wait until morning.

notes.arrival: Dan asked us to investigate unusual animal activity near Riverine Woodland. Pangolet is our first companion.
notes.first_bond: A first Wildbond formed. Ratelit appeared with stolen food; he seems determined to follow.
notes.injured_helped: Helped an injured Pangolet without forcing a bond. Ratelit stayed to investigate.
notes.tracks: Warm ground, fleeing wildlife and strange tracks lead north along the east bank.
notes.evidence: A collapsed shelter and a smooth black stone. The Band fell silent when Ratelit touched it.
notes.report: Dan asked us to build a sanctuary shelter: 6 wood, 2 stone, 4 fiber.
notes.shelter_cared: The sanctuary shelter now gives our companions a safe place to rest and recover.
notes.resonance: Ratelit withstood the Wild Current, then bit the stone. Dan has no explanation.
